decisions.reason: As a cutting and creasing finisher it is very close to the firm's core postpress know-how, so the firm can learn from early market feedback and improve or sell it with existing application, service, and training capabilities.

Because the UV spot varnishing system is relatively distant from the firm's established knowledge base and the website shows only an initial launch signal, the firm's absorptive capacity for interpreting results and developing the offer further appears weaker than for its core finishing lines.

A sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's established automation and finishing workflow expertise, making it easy to absorb customer feedback and integrate it into the broader portfolio.
The B2-format multifinisher system is close to the firm's existing offer and strongly matches its strategic move toward more automated, flexible, software-connected finishing workflows.
A hybrid saddle stitcher fits the firm's booklet-making and binding competence well, so the firm has the related knowledge and customer access needed to refine and commercialize it.

The folding add-on unit is closely related to the firm's installed base and already shows a concrete customer use case, which gives highly interpretable learning for further sales and application support.
